description: Build a self-healing edit plan that bundles locator pairs with test source code for the calling LLM to apply with its own editing tools. This tool does NOT modify files — it returns structured context so the LLM can edit only the relevant call sites (avoids blind find/replace across shared ids/classes). `sessions` accepts the canonical shape `[{sessionId, locators: [{original, healed, thought?}]}]`, a single session object, an envelope `{sessions: [...]}`, the raw report `{healing_logs: [...]}` (with `healed_selectors` aliasing `locators`), and snake_case keys (`session_id`, `original_locator`, `healed_locator`, `healing_thought`). Requires a session id. listSessions lists them for a build; if you do not have the build either, getBuildId or listBuildId resolves one from a project and build name.

sessions.description: Sessions to plan edits for. See tool description for accepted shapes.

locators.description: Healed locator pairs for this session.

name: prepareSelfHealingPlan
